_about: Player lines labelled with what the player is doing, for evaluating intent classification (backend/dialogue/intent.py). Written 2026-09-15 before any classifier was run on them. Labels: greeting, farewell, ack (acknowledgement / filler), recall (asks what the NPC remembers about the player), about_npc (asks the NPC about itself), question (any other question), report (tells the NPC about something happening in the world: an incident, theft, damage, danger), statement (anything else, including introductions and opinions). dev may be used while building; test is reported. Report lines were added 2026-09-15, before the report intent existed or any classifier was trained on it.
